claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[genetic modification] + factor value[genetic modification] rows 1-36
claims.value: mix1 (shFBL_int_rep1 fr1-8 + Feng_int_rep1_10p): SILAC heavy = shCtrl (rows 1-9), SILAC medium = shFBL (rows 10-18); mix2 (shFBL_int_rep2 fr1-8 + Feng_int_rep2_10p): SILAC heavy = shFBL (rows 19-27), SILAC medium = shCtrl (rows 28-36)
claims.evidence: NO WRITTEN SOURCE NAMES THE LABELS. PRIDE protocol / paper Methods state only that intermediate (2H4-Lys, 13C6-Arg) and heavy (15N2 13C6-Lys, 15N4 13C6-Arg) labelled lysates were merged and that "SILAC ratios were inverted to account for SILAC label swap between replicate experiments". The map is derived from the knock-down target's own ratios under the campaign-owner decision of 2026-11-10 for this dataset (rule 6 exception). FBL (P22087) Ratio H/M normalized: rep1 9.25, rep1_10p 7.95, rep2 0.151, rep2_10p 0.243 -> FBL is higher in heavy in mix1 (heavy = shCtrl) and lower in heavy in mix2 (heavy = shFBL). Table S4 top hits (log2FC nascent shFBL vs shCtrl) agree: LGR4 -3.98 (H/M rep1 23.9, rep2 0.080), MNDA -3.83 (35.7 / 0.173), CTSG -3.55 (18.0 / 0.136). log2 H/M rep1 vs rep2 Pearson r = -0.72 (n=5,819), matching Fig. S6A r = 0.73 after the label-swap inversion. Medium = intermediate label per the protocol (MaxQuant multiplicity 3, light channel empty; msms mass deltas confirm M = Lys4/Arg6 and H = Lys8/Arg10).

One source per labelled culture per SILAC mixture: MaxQuant experiments shFBL_int_rep1 / shFBL_int_rep2 are the two replicate mixtures (paper: "replicate experiments" with label swap; Fig. S6A "rep1"/"rep2"). Each source is one physical culture lysate; its fractions and its 10p injection are the same lysate.

claims.value: 1 = mix1 (rows 1-18), 2 = mix2 (rows 19-36), numbered within each factor-value group
claims.evidence: Two replicate nascent-proteomics experiments (Fig. S6A "Log2FC(shFBL/shCtrl).rep1" vs ".rep2"; Methods "label swap between replicate experiments"). Each shCtrl and each shFBL culture of a mixture is independent, so 1..2 within each group (rule 3).

The 10p injections are separate MaxQuant experiments of the SAME mixtures: their label pattern matches the parent mixture (marker_states.txt: Feng_int_rep1_10p 389 heavy vs 6 medium PSMs on rep1-heavy-high markers = rep1-like; Feng_int_rep2_10p 372 medium vs 11 heavy = rep2-like; FBL PSMs in rep1_10p all heavy (14), rep2_10p all medium (13)); log2 H/M rep1 vs rep1_10p r=0.59, rep2 vs rep2_10p r=0.82. They were acquired on 2018-12-17, before the fractions (2018-12-18), with the same method HCD_2H5M_T20_HI.meth; "10p" is read as a ~10% unfractionated aliquot injection (the deposit does not define it), so they are a second technical replicate of each mixture, not a fraction.

limitations: CHANNEL MAP WITHOUT A WRITTEN SOURCE: the label-to-condition map rests on the knock-down target FBL's own deposited H/M ratios (plus Table S4 top-hit agreement and the rep1/rep2 anticorrelation), accepted by the campaign owner on 2026-11-10 for this dataset only; no publication, PRIDE text or supplementary header states which label carried shCtrl or shFBL.

Partial scope: only the FBL-knockdown arm (18 Q Exactive HF RAW) is annotated. Not annotated: the SNORD127 arm, 32 Orbitrap Fusion RAW 20190301_FS1_DF_snoRNA_{1..4}_{1..8}.raw (search output proteinGroups.txt/msms.txt, experiments SNOR5D127_KO_C1_rep1/rep2, C34_rep1/rep2) - its channel map and raw-to-experiment map are undocumented (BLOCKED.md).

Excluded run: 20181218_QE1_DF_shFBL_int_rep2_fr1_10p.raw (1,074,606 bytes; acquired as 20181218_QE1_DF_Feng_int_rep1_fr1_10p.raw) - an aborted/stub acquisition, absent from msmss_shFBL_0712019.txt (18 raw files there) and not part of any MaxQuant experiment.
"10p" is not defined in the deposit; it is read as an unfractionated ~10% aliquot injection of each mixture (technical replicate 2). The data confirm which mixture each belongs to.
Europe PMC returned HTTP 503 throughout, so a Europe PMC search for a dataset-descriptor paper could not be run; PRIDE references list only the Cancer Discovery paper.

No summary.txt / parameters.txt / mqpar.xml: MaxQuant version, enzyme rule, tolerances and Multi modifications are unrecorded; precursor/fragment tolerance are not available, so parse_sdrf convert-openms exits 1 (as for campaign precedents PXD014368, PXD006676).

Which shRNA construct (constitutive pLKO.1 vs doxycycline-inducible Tet-pLKO) and the exact pulse length (Methods 3 h labelling; Results "6-hour time window") are not stated for the proteomics; not encoded.
